GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (29 Jun 46) LS
(SCAPIN-1044)
APO 500
29 June 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Results of War Crimes Trials.
1. Notice is hereby given of the following results of War Crimes Trials as reported by Military Commission Order Number 22, General Headquarters, United States Army Forces, Pacific, 31 May 1946.
ACCUSED DESIGNATION PLACE OF TRIAL RESULT OF TRIAL
Satoru ONO Capt., attached 53rd Field Anti-Aircraft Bn., 36th Div., 2nd Army. Manila Guilty. Sentenced to be hanged.
2. Notice is hereby given of the following results of War Crimes Trials as reported by Military Commission Order Number 5, Headquarters, United States Army Forces, Western Pacific, 31 May 1946.
Mitsuji TANAKA Maj., assignment unknown, stationed at Fuga Island, Luzon,P.I. on or about 20 June 45. Manila Guilty. Life Imprisonment.
Kyuemon ITO M/Sgt.,-attached 407th Ind. Inf. Bn., 61st IMB. Manila Guilty. 20 years Imprisonment.
Hiroshi WAKAMORI Cpl., assignment unknown, stationed at Fuga Island, Luzon, P.I. on or about 20 June 45. Manila Guilty. 10 years Imprisonment.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
